content:
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] 2543 — elevated p95 generation latency for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (detected 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC). Pager fired. Affected customers: 3 active sessions; some retries seen.
elaine: I'm primary for the next 4h, taking ownership. observed spike coincides with a rolling canary deploy on dedicated pool.
raj: saw the same. autoscaler was glancing at nodes, some pods in CrashLoopBackOff for a few mins.
nick: quick status: metrics show batch sizes jumped -> CPU Q wait increased; KV-cache hit rate dropped from 96% -> 70% around 03:10.
elaine: thanks. immediate mitigation: pin traffic to older model variant in eu-west using routing override. Rolling this now. @ash can you validate routing change once done? :thumbsup:
ash: on it. applying override: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --model rwd-v2-2025 --weight 100`
ash: applied, verifying traffic drain...
ash: confirm: 100% routed to rwd-v2-2025. no more canary traffic.
raj: monitoring latency panels. p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 700ms within 3 min after override. KV-cache warmup happening.
elaine: customer impact: degraded response times (p95 ~1.8s) for ~8 minutes and transient 429 retries. No data loss. Affected: two enterprise clients saw elevated error rates in their dashboards.
nick: runbook pointer: internal runbook for cache-pressure and canary rollbacks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-pressure (see section: rollback + staged abort).
oncall-bot: runbook-bot attached: `runbook-bot: recommended playbook: rollback canary -> increase cache replicas -> monitor steady-state 15m`.
elaine: action items (short): 1) keep routing override for 1h, 2) increase cache replicas in eu-west by +2, 3) investigate canary resource config (possible lower mem/cpu causing OOMs).
ash: scaling cache replicas: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment kv-cache-eu-west --replicas=5` (was 3).
ash: scaled, pods starting. logs show warmup.
raj: I'll open a follow-up issue to audit canary resource limits and autoscaler thresholds: LINK https://jira.redwood/browse/OPS-1234
elaine: handoff notes for next shift: primary=ash (taking second half of window), secondary=raj. timebox: keep override until rollback root-cause triage complete. if p95 > 1.2s again, escalate to infra pager.
ash: taking primary at 07:00 UTC handoff. I'll keep eyes for 30m then ping for full handover.
nick: added dashboard snapshots and logs to incident ticket. saved traces: s3://rwd-ops/incident-2543/traces-20260314.zip
elaine: closing immediate pager state: mitigated -> no customer retries for 15m. leaving open for postmortem. next steps documented in ticket.
ash: ack, will pick this up. tagging @oncall-bot to mark handoff. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Incident 2543 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Handed off to ash as primary at 04:05 UTC.
ash: thanks. if anyone sees re-spike, ping me directly. otherwise I'll file a short postmortem and propose canary resource guardrails.
elaine: thanks team. short notes attached to ticket with commands run and times. good handoff.
